name: headline-stat
title: Headline stat
description: One number set enormous with the sentence that explains it, backed by three smaller figures and an honest source line.
docs: Pass value (a number counts up once as it enters the view, through CountUp; a string is set as written), prefix, suffix, decimals and locale for a number, then label (the section's heading), description, supporting ({ value, label }; three read best) and source ({ text, href? }). The figure is sized to its column from the length it will have, so '$128.4M' shrinks to fit. The final value is in the page from the first render, and under reduced motion nothing counts.
